title: Go SDK: struct-mapper generics for chunked/streamed structured output
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Problem: Go SDK users need ergonomics for decoding LLM responses that arrive as interleaved/partial JSON chunks (e.g., streaming structured output with intermediate tokens, tool-calls, and nested objects). Existing helpers focus on single-shot unmarshal or simple envelope patterns; they are brittle for incremental decoders and backpressure scenarios. Goal: introduce a small set of generic 'struct-mapper' helpers and a streaming resolver API that let callers declare typed Go structs (or interfaces) and receive safely-merged, validated instances as chunks arrive, while preserving retry/resume semantics and predictable memory usage. Constraints: keep public surface minimal, avoid heavy runtime reflection for common paths, maintain compatibility with existing stream combinators and retry middleware. This ticket implements the core mapper + examples + tests and lands a small ergonomic wrapper for typical chat/tool-call flows.
acceptance_criteria: A typed StructMapper generic is available: MapChunks[T any](ctx, stream) -> <-chan T, where T can be any unmarshallable struct
Incremental decoding preserves partial fields across chunk boundaries (e.g., array elements appended across multiple events)
Backpressure: the mapper respects consumer capacity and does not unboundedly buffer tokens (configurable max tokens/bytes)
Retry-safe: if a request is retried from an earlier prefix, mapper can reset/resume without leaking state
Minimal reflection hot-path: benchmarks show <15% overhead vs raw json.Unmarshal for non-streaming cases
Comprehensive unit tests for nested structs, arrays across chunks, and error propagation
Two example snippets (chat with function call, embeddings metadata stream) in examples/ demonstrating typical usage and migration notes
steps: Design API sketch and validate with SDK maintainers (internal doc linked below)
Implement core incremental JSON combiner that merges partial tokens into a compact buffer
Implement StructMapper generic wrapper and typed channel emitter with cancellation support
Wire mapper into existing stream combinators and add an options struct for buffer limits and retry hooks
Write unit tests for edge cases: out-of-order chunk fields, empty chunks, truncated JSON, oversized messages
Benchmark common paths and tune reflection vs encoding/json trade-offs
Add two end-to-end examples and a small migration guide in the repo
Open PR, request review from runtime/streams and go-sdk owners, iterate on feedback
